title.en: National Council of Social Service (Sector Membership) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 10 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the National Council of Social Service (Sector Membership) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 1 August 2026.

heading.en: Conditions for appointment or re-appointment as sector member
Application for appointment or re-appointment as sector member

text.en:
3.—(1) An application for appointment or re‑appointment as a sector member must be made to the Council in the form and manner required by the Council.
(2) The Council must consider every duly completed application and communicate its decision in writing to the applicant.
(3) The Council may reject an application for appointment or re‑appointment as a sector member without giving any reason.

heading.en: Appointment and re-appointment of organisations as sector members

text.en:
4.—(1) Where the Council is satisfied that an organisation is suitable for appointment or re‑appointment as a sector member, the Council may appoint or re‑appoint (as the case may be) that organisation as a sector member under section 15(1) of the Act.
(2) When appointing or re-appointing an organisation as a sector member under section 15(1) of the Act, the Council may specify an expiry date for the appointment.

heading.en: Nominations by sector members of proposed members of Council

text.en:
6. Every sector member must —
(a)submit a certified copy of its annual report, audited accounts and balance‑sheet to the Council within 6 months from the end of its financial year; and
(b)furnish to the Council such information with respect to its organisation and functions, in such manner and at such times, as the Council may reasonably require.

heading.en: Resignation from appointment as sector member

text.en: 7. A sector member may at any time resign as a sector member by giving the Council 3 months’ notice in writing of its intention to do so, or any shorter period that the Council may allow.

heading.en: Revocation of appointment as sector member

text.en: 9. In these Regulations, where the Council or Chairperson is required to give a sector member written notice or inform a sector member in writing, the Council or Chairperson (as the case may be) may do so by post, delivery or electronic communication.
10. Revoke the National Council of Social Service (Membership and Fees) Regulations (Rg 3).
